title: Block-caret prompt with swapping slot and app tile
summary: A glowing block caret types and erases the name, types a three-line terminal-style promise whose bracketed noun swaps under a glowing selection, types a short call to action, then hard-cuts to the app tile on a violet haze.
use_when: Developer tools, CLIs or coding agents that want a terminal voice
A 10 s intro or bumper where one sentence plus a variable noun carries the pitch
Showing breadth (many things you can make) without any UI
Closing on an app icon rather than a wordmark

look.type_style: geometric grotesk regular, sentence case, normal tracking; name ~6 % H, prompt lines ~6 % H stepped right line by line; swap word in mono inside brackets; prompt glyph in lavender mono

sfx.event: slot word swaps under the glowing selection
two sparkle dots after the call to action completes
app tile lands after the hard cut

structure.shot: glowing block caret alone on dark violet haze, types the product name (one word), holds, then erases it
structure.camera: static frame; background gradient blobs drift (motion.json 0.3 %/s, background only)
structure.motion: typewriter ~2 chars per 0.25 s (0.27-0.77), caret halo shifts magenta -> cyan -> blue while typing; caret hides at 0.77; name holds ~7 fr then erases from the left side 1.00-1.50 (±0.25 s); text moves off-centre left between 0.77 and 1.00 (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: terminal prompt glyph appears, then a three-line promise types on: 3 words, 2 words with a bracketed mono slot word, 2 words; each line steps right
structure.camera: static frame; background drift (motion.json 0.7-1.2 %/s, background only)
structure.motion: typewriter: line 1 by 1.77, line 2 with bracket slot 2.00-2.50, line 3 2.77-3.00 (±0.25 s); slot word in lavender mono brackets

structure.shot: the slot word swaps twice (3 nouns total) under a cyan glowing selection box, then the whole block erases
structure.motion: word-swap: swap 1 at 3.50 with cyan selection fill + bloom glow ~0.25 s, swap 2 at 4.27 (no glow visible at 4 fps); hold ~1 s; erase 5.27-5.50 (±0.25 s), lines erase back from the end

structure.shot: two-word call to action (verb + product name) typed by a glowing block caret, centred, larger type (~9 % H); two sparkle dots flank it once
structure.camera: static frame; background drift (motion.json 1.6 %/s, background only)
structure.motion: typewriter 5.77-6.00 (±0.25 s), caret halo violet -> blue; caret vanishes at 6.27 leaving 2 white sparkle dots for ~1 cell; hold 6.27-7.50 (~37 fr); text gone by 7.70 (exit not measurable)

structure.shot: white rounded app tile with the product glyph, centred on a brighter blue-violet field; a dark haze blob drifts on the right
structure.camera: static; background blob sweeps right to upper right
structure.motion: tile enters large (~30 % W at 7.73) and settles to ~11 % W by 8.00, springs.cameraOut ~8 fr (overshoot not measurable); holds to the end

params.content.name: product name typed and erased in the hook (one word)
params.content.promise: three short lines, 3 / 2 / 2 words, line 2 holds the slot
params.content.slotWords: 3 nouns cycled in the bracket slot, mono font
params.content.cta: two-word call to action: verb + name
params.content.tile: app icon image for the end tile
params.caretColors: caret halo colours cycled while typing (default magenta, cyan, blue)

notes: One shot 0-7.73 s plus one hard cut to the tile; no glitch cut is visible despite the catalogue hint. Text appears only by typing and leaves only by erasing. Cut 7.73 is 2.8 fr from beat 7.64, so cut_on_beat 0/1. Typing speed, caret blink and erase speed measured at 4 fps only (±0.25 s). Zoom values in motion.json come from the drifting background blobs, the text does not scale. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (music-only reference). Proposed terms (not used as ids): glow-block-caret, tile-land.
